summary: Tested 4 bugs in Manufacturing ERP. All backend tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI verification confirmed Bug 2 fix (SC button hidden for in_progress MOs). Bug 3 (auto-complete MO when last op done) and Bug 4 (SC dialog auto-creates SC order) verified via backend tests.
passed_tests: Bug 3 Backend: MO auto-completes when last operation is completed
Bug 3 Backend: Stock is incremented when MO auto-completes
Bug 4 Backend: Mark MO as subcontract works correctly
Bug 4 Backend: create-sc endpoint works after marking MO as subcontract
Bug 2 Backend: in_progress MO data shows correct status for button visibility logic
Bug 2 Backend: pending MO can show SC button (status !== 'in_progress')
Bug 1 Backend: DC shortage response includes item name alongside part number
Regression: Inhouse Start works for pending MOs
Bug 2 Frontend: in_progress non-subcontract MO shows only Job Card button (no SC, no Complete)
Bug 2 Frontend: SC button visible for pending MOs (when hasActiveChild is false)
critical_code_review_comments: Bug 2 Frontend (ManufacturingPage.js line 1090): Complete button correctly shows ONLY when wo.status === 'in_progress' && !wo.is_subcontract && ops.length === 0
Bug 2 Frontend (ManufacturingPage.js line 1092): SC button correctly shows ONLY when canShowSC && wo.status !== 'in_progress'
Bug 3 Backend (server.py lines 4466-4479): Auto-completes MO and increments stock when all operations are completed
Bug 4 Frontend (ManufacturingPage.js lines 355-376): handleConfirmSubcontract correctly does Step 1 (mark as SC) + Step 2 (auto create-sc)
seed_data_creation: Test items (FG, RM), suppliers, work centers, routings, BOMs, SOs, and MOs created during backend testing with unique UUID suffixes for isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bugs verified: Bug 1 (DC shortage shows item name) - already fixed in iteration 33. Bug 2 (button visibility) - SC button hidden for in_progress MOs, Complete button only for ops.length===0. Bug 3 (auto-complete MO) - works when last operation completed. Bug 4 (SC dialog auto-creates SC order) - handleConfirmSubcontract calls create-sc endpoint after marking MO as subcontract.

bug1_dc_shortage_item_name.details: DC shortage response includes both part number (item) and name fields

bug2_button_visibility.details: in_progress MO (not subcontract) shows only Job Card button. SC button hidden when status is in_progress. Complete button shows only when ops.length === 0.

bug3_auto_complete_mo.details: When last operation is completed via PUT /api/work-orders/{id}/operations/{seq}, MO auto-completes and stock is incremented

bug4_sc_dialog_auto_create.details: handleConfirmSubcontract does Step 1 (mark as SC) + Step 2 (auto call create-sc endpoint). SC order created immediately after confirming SC dialog.
